fusions.name: Set the Second Barb
fusions.desc: A strike that needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up, dealing 8 damage and leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: No Throwing Back
fusions.desc: Throws a heavy double-barbed line that deals 28 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leaves the target [Inescapable] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Catch and Return
fusions.desc: For 6 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it instead.

fusions.name: Deeper Every Time
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on that enemy, up to 4. At 4 they all spend at once: a blow strikes it for 41% of your weapon damage per stack (163% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
